title: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A Streamlit-based tool for generating synthetic tabular data, importing Faker and profiling utilities alongside a GAN-based synthesizer; requirements.txt also lists the sdv and rdt packages as part of the CTGAN ecosystem, but the code directly imports and appears to run the standalone CTGAN package for synthetic data generation.
evidence: app.py:4 'from ctgan import CTGAN'; requirements.txt lists ctgan==0.10.1, sdv==1.15.0, rdt==1.12.1 under '# CTGAN ecosystem'
needs: No README available to confirm project name or intent; no explicit CTGAN.fit()/sample() call site captured, and sdv/rdt appear only in requirements.txt with no usage evidence.
